description: This file defines custom exception classes related to charts and dashboards in the Superset project, including validation errors, command errors, and specific chart-related exceptions.

classes.name: TimeRangeAmbiguousError
classes.description: ValidationError indicating an ambiguous time range string.

classes.name: TimeRangeParseFailError
classes.description: ValidationError indicating failure to parse a time string.

classes.name: TimeDeltaAmbiguousError
classes.description: ValidationError indicating an ambiguous time delta.

classes.name: DatasourceTypeUpdateRequiredValidationError
classes.description: ValidationError when datasource type is missing.

classes.name: ChartDeleteFailedReportsExistError
classes.description: Error when reports or alerts exist for chart.

classes.name: ChartAccessDeniedError
classes.description: ForbiddenError for access denial to chart.

classes.name: WarmUpCacheChartNotFoundError
classes.description: CommandException with 404 status for missing chart.

classes.name: ChartFaveError
classes.description: CommandException for errors favoriting a chart.

classes.name: ChartUnfaveError
classes.description: CommandException for errors unfavoriting a chart.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for validation errors with specific messages.
